statement: A Florida corporation changes its registered agent or registered office with the Division of Corporations for a $35 fee on the Division's corporate fee schedule, and every corporation registering in Florida pays a $35 registered-agent designation fee alongside the $35 filing fee at registration.
caveat: The statutory basis is Chapter 607, Florida Statutes (§§ 607.0501-607.0502 for domestic, § 607.1508-607.1509 for foreign corporations), not carded here; a registered agent's own resignation costs $87.50 while the corporation is active. dos.fl.gov 403s plain non-browser clients, so verification used a standard browser user agent. This repo does not file the change.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state process variants wave 2026-10-22); independent domain expert review pending
